validation.scope: Q2 only: source/process controls and optical validation; no complete-device fabrication or common-voltage proof

capacity_source_control.HTML_header_note: The HTML labels mm^-1; linked raw files explicitly label um^-1. Use raw header for charge units, do not silently infer.
capacity_source_control.qualification: Different compounds, voltage windows and specimens: this is a transfer diagnostic, not an identified charge law for the proposed device. LBNL LiNiO endpoints cannot certify sputtered NiO operation.

limits: EC factors scale spectral contrast only; not a physical voltage, ionic-diffusion or equilibrium model.
Phase mixing is a fixed constitutive sensitivity with s=1/3, not a fitted transition on mica.
NiO/WO3 source charge endpoints are not the working state spectra of Dong2018 device.
Actual Dong2018 dimensions deliberately test the earlier capacity-ratio assumption; using different optical endpoints is still a process transfer.
Mica and electrolyte remain proxies. Coherence/angle/loss/retention are finite diagnostics, not fabrication tolerances.
Source Film1 is sputtered on Si; mica fabrication precedent narrows process choice but does not validate transferred n,k.
Actual LiTaO3 optical/ionic response and common pair of applied voltages at both temperatures remain missing.

actual_mica_specimen_trace.source: Gentle, Maaroof and Smith, Temperature dependence of optical and transport properties in VO2 with high temperature anomalies, Figure2

sample.substrate: mica, thickness not specified numerically in the plot/experimental text
sample.process: DC sputtered V then450C controlled oxidation/anneal ~6h,0.1Torr air introduction
sample.states: semiconductor and metallic phases, exact plotted endpoint temperatures not labeled

limits: Published raster digitization, not raw spectrophotometer data or fitted optical constants.
Native pixel data and full source range retained. NIR band endpoints use small edge clamps, no broad spectral extrapolation.
The plotted120nm VO2/mica specimen is not an8um mica device, source Film1, or source Film4.
Adding a cap/AR changes the spectrum; the observed trace cannot be reused as the capped structure.
Plot semiconductor/metal endpoint temperatures are not numerically labeled; do not call this30/100C or25/80C four-state evidence.
Pixel diagnostics are not measurement errors or confidence intervals.

counts: shared mica1 +TC VO2+early protection2 +EC functional5 +shared final cap1 =9; adjacent caps retained as separate fabrication entities.
